title: 留饮
author: rhyme_scene
authorLimit: 谁人与我酬 uses 酬 in its literary wine-toasting sense; it is not everyday diction.
revisionNote: Independent draft by rhyme_scene; the editor changed 且 to 火 at (3,2), improving 灯火与君留 and 风寒火暖酒 together. Earlier 伴 at the central cell was revised by the author to 与.

curation.short: A cold room becomes an invitation to stay.
curation.reason: Both readings sustain the same hospitable interior but organize it differently. Across, the cold window gives way to lamplight, emotional warmth and wine offered to a friend. Down, the familiar light leads through warming wine and exchanging toasts to asking the friend to stay. Replacing 且 with 火 made both the lamp line and the wine-warming line more concrete; two independent cross-readers accepted the revised pair.
curation.weakness: 谁人与我酬 and 劝醉君如旧 are distinctly literary. 影暖我如旧 transfers emotional warmth to a shadow; the preceding 灯火 supports it, but it remains a conspicuous metaphor.
curation.reading: Read 风寒／火暖酒 as two clauses: the wind is cold; the fire warms the wine. 酬 has its wine-toasting sense, supported by the surrounding 酒、醉、友. The opening question does not establish an absent or dead friend.

shortAssessment: A cold room becomes an invitation to stay.
selectionNote: Across, lamplight and the familiar shadow soften the cold window; down, warming wine becomes exchanging toasts and keeping a friend a little longer. The same room supports two connected movements rather than two unrelated collections of images.
rhymeLabel: 十欧 · → 酒 后 留 旧 友 · ↓ 旧 酒 酬 旧 友

lexicalSources.title: 汉典：酬
lexicalSources.supports: The wine-toasting sense of 酬, not a judgment of this poem’s fluency.

title: 归去
author: rhyme_turn_round3
authorLimit: Three lines are shared. 枕青烟 is deliberate personification, carried into the literal 旧枕.

curation.short: Human and bird exchange return and departure.
curation.reason: The smallest change produces the strongest new atmospheric contrast: 人归／去鸟 becomes 人去／归鸟. The old pillow, curtains and distant hills stay fixed while the human presence changes. The literal pillow gives the bird’s figurative pillow a bodily counterpart; the repeated 掩 connects the room with the veiled mountains. Both external readers selected it, and the fresh comparative reader ranked it first.
curation.weakness: 去鸟枕青烟 combines departure with repose more daringly than 归鸟枕青烟. Three full lines are shared; this is a restrained change of perspective, not two independent stories.
curation.reading: 枕青烟 is a visual metaphor, not a claim that birds literally sleep on mist. 旧枕重帘掩 places the old pillow behind layered curtains. 柳青／帘外晚 juxtaposes the green willow and dusk outside the curtain. No bereavement, abandoned marriage, or subsequent bird landing is specified.

shortAssessment: Human and bird exchange return and departure.
selectionNote: The person returns while the bird leaves; turn the square and the person leaves while the bird returns. The unchanged pillow and curtains make the exchange matter. Three shared lines act as a fixed scene against which presence and absence change.
rhymeLabel: 十一安 · → 寒 烟 掩 晚 山 · ↓ 寒 烟 掩 晚 山

title: 绣愁
author: rhyme_intimate_round3 + editor
revisionNote: Collaborative work, not an independent one-shot: the fresh author supplied the embroidery scene and both rhyming borders; the editor completed the square using part of the earlier 旧楼 scaffold; the author refined 唯/有/忘 to 方/识/如. Earlier 旧楼 remains unchanged.
authorLimit: 故问愁谁有 is literary question-word inversion; repeated 旧 binds the theme but exposes the construction.

curation.short: Stitching sorrow becomes finding sorrow hard to stitch.
curation.reason: The most substantial new change of meaning: 识 moves from recognizing an old friend in an image to understanding the difficulty of expressing sorrow. 瘦手绣旧愁 gives that difficulty a bodily, material answer. 人老难如旧 and 念旧谁如旧 connect remembered likeness with changed bodies. The editor and one cross-reader selected it; the fresh comparative reader preferred Reserve because its connective lines are less effortless. It ranks below 归舟 for evenness, above 留饮 for the force of its central transformation.
curation.weakness: 故问愁谁有 is the loosest connection and uses literary question-word inversion. 对图问老手 is functional rather than especially lyrical. Four occurrences of 旧 unify the subject but also reveal the construction.
curation.reading: The image contains a recognizable old friend; the vertical reading asks an experienced hand about the image and discovers sorrow is difficult to embroider. 老手 means an experienced practitioner, not necessarily the same person as the thin friend. The text does not establish a photograph rather than another image, an actual reunion, or anyone’s gender. 难绣 means difficult, not impossible.

shortAssessment: Stitching sorrow becomes finding sorrow hard to stitch.
selectionNote: Recognizing an old friend in an image becomes recognizing the limits of an art. The thin hand nevertheless stitches the old sorrow. The two readings hold effort and difficulty together; they do not cancel each other out.
rhymeLabel: 十欧 · → 旧 友 有 旧 愁 · ↓ 瘦 手 绣 旧 愁
